image_description: A side-profile view of a large American Bison standing in a grassy field with green trees and a wire fence in the background. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump, transitioning to smoother, darker fur on the hindquarters. It features a large head with short curved horns, a beard, and sturdy legs. There is red text overlay in the bottom left corner.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible, broad, and possesses short, light-colored curved horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct fringe of long, dark hair hangs from the chin and throat area.
The eye is visible and appears dark/black, matching the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick mane/fur of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and height at the shoulders typical of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The texture is visibly shaggy and woolly on the front half, creating a very distinct, high shoulder hump.
There is a clear visual transition from the shaggy front to the smoother, shorter-haired rear flank and legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively small in proportion to the massive head and body.
While the legs are sturdy, the feet/hooves are obscured by the tall grass in the foreground, making verification of the 'cloven' detail impossible.
The tail is visible hanging down behind the hind legs and ends in a dark, bushy switch.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Red digital text overlay ('31 2014' or similar) is present. While likely a camera timestamp added post-generation or part of the source image, it constitutes an artifact relative to a clean natural scene generation. It is legible but visually intrusive.
The wire fence in the background shows slight irregularities in spacing and straightness, common in AI generations where rigid geometric structures often warp slightly.
